response.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, risk_margin_records, 1.0 * risk_margin_records / SUM(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, risk_margin_records / AVG(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts;

assumptions.assumption: Matched users with a NULL acctscope form a NULL scope group.

alternatives.interpretation: Only non-NULL account scopes should be reported and included in the denominators.
alternatives.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_records FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp WHERE u.acctscope IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, risk_margin_records, 1.0 * risk_margin_records / SUM(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, risk_margin_records / AVG(risk_margin_records) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scope_counts;
